name: Access Communications
summary: Early Western Australian ISP (Access Communications (WA) Pty Ltd, ACN 068 763 609; website accesswa.com.au), acquired by iiNet c. Dec 1996 (some sources: Dec 1997).

events.details: Acquired by iiNet Technologies in December 1997 (iiNet's own archived redirect page for the absorbed company: 'In December 1997, Access Communications was acquired by Perth's leading Internet provider iiNet Technologies (that's us)'). Note: iiNet's later-compressed 'through the years' history grouped this with Online Information Systems as 1996, and the 1998-era iiNet timeline listed it under Dec 1997; the primary archived source confirms Dec 1997.

refs.label: iiNet archived page: 'Access Communications has moved' — acquired by iiNet Dec 1997

events.details: Domain identified as accesswa.com.au (not access.net.au, which belongs to Access Net Australia): Kim Davies' Australian ISP List (Apr 1997) entry for Access Communications lists Web Site http://www.accesswa.com.au/, email tbontes@accesswa.com.au. accesswa.com.au captured by Wayback from 18 Apr 1998.
